repo.description:
## Impact

OpenBao's Agent and Proxy services can be configured via `require_request_header = true` to require the `X-Vault-Header`  on all requests to help prevent Server Side Request Forgery attacks. Requests to the quit endpoints (`/agent/v1/quit` and `/proxy/v1/quit`) previously did correctly require this header, potentially allowing an attacker to stop these services. This is also true of the `/agent/v1/cache-clear` and `/proxy/v1/cache-clear` endpoints but with no material security impact.

This vulnerability is original to HashiCorp Vault.

## Patch

This vulnerability is patched in OpenBao v2.7.0 and v2.6.3.
repo.summary: OpenBao's Agent/Proxy Allows Exiting Without Required Header
